The [[Glacial Griffon]] is a [[Spirit spammer|spirit lord]] [[Griffon]] [[boss]] that you have to fight solo for the [[Cold as Ice]] [[quest]]. It brings a combination of [[spirit]]s that can shut down a wide variety of builds and deal plenty of damage, and it has continuous, inherent regeneration.

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Sifhalla}} (only during  [[Cold as Ice]])

==Skills==
14 [[Channeling Magic]], 16 [[Communing]] (20 Channeling Magic, 20 Communing in [[hard mode]])
*{{Skill icon|Bloodsong}}
*{{Skill icon|Dissonance}}
*{{Skill icon|Pain}}
*{{Skill icon|Ritual Lord}} ([[elite]])
*{{Skill icon|Shadowsong}}

==Notes==
* The quest and talk pages of [[Cold As Ice]] show multiple ways on how to defeat the Glacial Griffon.
* In hard mode, Ritual Lord does not increase its Channeling Magic nor Communing ranks, since [[attribute]]s are [[Effect stacking|capped]] at rank 20.
